family.description: 8k conversion (sealed confirmation v2, release decision 3): one family file read once per primary comparison, D1 A1-A0, D2 A2-A1, D3 A3-A2, D4 A4-A3, each read by claude-sonnet-5-5 and judged by gpt-4o-2024-08-06, and once for F1's non-inferiority (A1 against R5). Judged answer correctness over all 200 questions, paired by question and clustered by persona (haystack). The verdict is decideC8k's, not compare.ts's report-only verdict; the Holm correction over D1 to D4 is applied there because compare.ts sees one pair at a time.

comparisons.description: Each primary comparison (D1 to D4: the later configuration B against the one before it, A) and F1's non-inferiority check (A1 as B against R5 as A). Read by the preregistered rule (decideC8k in eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/c8k.ts): Holm over the four exact two-sided McNemar p values, the persona-clustered 95% bootstrap interval, guards 7 and 8; for F1 the interval's lower bound against -0.05. compare.ts reports it without a verdict.
Every gold chat among the chats the reader saw (the conversation pages named by the rows kept in the context), over the answerable questions. Descriptive.

reasons: McNemar treats items as independent; the clustered sign-flip p-value is the primary test here

power.note: no paired variation was observed, so the detectable effect cannot be estimated from this data; an exact McNemar test needs at least 6 wins with zero losses to reach 0.05
